question.problem:
What is the circumference $C$ of a circle with a radius of $6?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14183030/assets/3c21021529285f488ca794a442e5826a033ed2a4c6f4fad53ab9e8fdc84d35ee.png)
question.worked_solution:
We use the formula $C=2\pi r$ to get

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =2\pi r \\  & =2\pi \cdot 6 \\  & =12\pi .\end{aligned}
$$
